import z3

N = 54
max_v = 27
s = z3.Solver()

# placements[v][k] means v placed at position k (0-based), covering k and k+(v+1)
placements = {}
for v in range(1, max_v + 1):
    d = v + 1
    num_pos = N - d
    placements[v] = [z3.Bool(f'p_{v}_{k}') for k in range(num_pos)]

# Each v exactly once
for v in range(1, max_v + 1):
    s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(b, 1, 0) for b in placements[v]]) == 1)

# For each position, exactly one claim (since 2*27=54, at most one implies exactly one)
for i in range(N):
    claims = []
    for v in range(1, max_v + 1):
        d = v + 1
        # if starts at i
        if i < (N - d):
            claims.append(placements[v][i])
        # if ends at i, i.e. starts at i - d
        if i - d >= 0 and (i - d) < (N - d):
            claims.append(placements[v][i - d])
    s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(b, 1, 0) for b in claims]) == 1)

print(s.check())
